description: Get an account's Life and Work resume: all its claims (expertise, work history, education, good deeds, intellectual property) with endorsements. Read-only; no signature. Optional `caller`: the account whose view to read (for caller-dependent results). Results are paginated with `offset` and `limit` (default 50, max 200).

caller.description: Optional account address (SS58) to run the query as
